title: When the Mythical Man-Month Meets Agentic Web Systems: Structured Coordination for Scalable Development
abstract: arXiv:2611.19140v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As agentic systems are increasingly deployed to support complex Web tasks, multi-agent architectures offer greater parallelism, specialization, and task coverage. However, increasing the number of agents does not necessarily improve system performance, as communication, synchronization, redundant work, and coordination overhead may offset the benefits of additional agents. This presents a fundamental scaling challenge for agentic Web systems: how can agent populations be organized to balance task performance and coordination costs? To address this challenge, we systematically investigate the relationship between agent population size, per-agent token consumption, and coordination overhead in collaborative agentic systems. translated_title: 当“人月神话”遇见智能体网络系统：面向可扩展开发的结构化协调
translated_abstract: 随着智能体系统日益被部署用于支持复杂的网络任务，多智能体架构能够提供更强的并行性、专业化和任务覆盖能力。然而，增加智能体数量并不一定能提升系统性能，因为通信、同步、冗余工作和协调开销可能会抵消额外智能体所带来的收益。这给智能体网络系统提出了一个根本性的扩展挑战：如何组织智能体种群，以平衡任务性能与协调成本？为应对这一挑战，我们系统性地研究了协作式智能体系统中智能体种群规模、单智能体token消耗与协调开销之间的关系。在复杂的面向网络的软件开发任务上进行的实验揭示了一种非线性扩展模式：随着智能体种群规模的增长，单智能体的token消耗最初呈下降趋势，但最终会表现出收益递减的现象。
tldr: 本文借鉴软件工程经典著作《人月神话》的思想，系统揭示了多智能体系统中智能体规模与协调开销之间的非线性关系，并提出结构化协调方法以在任务性能与协调成本之间取得平衡，从而实现可扩展的智能体网络系统开发。
en_tdlr: Drawing on the classic insight of "The Mythical Man-Month," this paper systematically reveals the non-linear relationship between agent population size and coordination overhead in multi-agent systems, and proposes structured coordination to balance task performance and coordination costs for scalable agentic Web system development.
